nom: Seoul Ceuticals Korean Skin Care PDRN + Vitamin C Serum

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with somewhat sensitive skin reports no irritation or tingling at all, alongside brighter, firmer, more hydrated skin within the first week.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports her laugh lines became noticeably lighter with use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report firmer, more hydrated skin with regular use, describing it as adding hydration without feeling sticky, greasy, or oily.

aspects.libelle: Skepticism about hype versus actual ingredient list
Multi-purpose formula reduces need for separate products
Layers well under moisturizer and makeup

extraits.texte: This is a just anothet over hyped korean skin care product. I should have read the ingredients before I purchased it. Top ingrediants are : witch hazel, aloe vera and jojoba oil. I gave it 2 stars for scent and how it felt on skin. But the crosspolymer ingredient is a no.

extraits.titre: Noticeably Brighter, Healthier Skin Without the Irritation
extraits.texte: I've been using the Seoul Ceuticals PDRN + Vitamin C Serum for a couple weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed with how balanced it feels on my skin. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky or greasy residue. I have somewhat sensitive skin, and this serum didn't cause any irritation or tingling at all. Within the first week, my skin started looking brighter and more even, especially around my cheeks. After continued use, I noticed my skin felt firmer and more hydrated overall. It layers well under moisturizer and makeup, which is a big plus for my morning routine. I also like that it doesn't have a strong scent. My skin looks healthier and more refreshed, even on days when I'm tired. The combination of PDRN and Vitamin C feels gentle but effective. It's one of those products that quietly works in the background. I'll definitely be keeping this serum in my regular skincare rotation.

extraits.titre: My Skin is So Soft After Use!
extraits.texte: I love this skin care product, nothing has ever left my skin so soft! It is a great base for any beauty routine. I apply this before my lotion in the morning. My laugh lines are noticeably lighter. I will continue use for a younger face. 10/10!

I really like this serum because it's several products in one, so I don't have to spend as much on a variety of bottles, and I'm getting great results. The serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky. My skin looks fresh and not dull, and it feels soft. I use this serum after cleaning my face in the morning and I follow it with moisturizer. Definitely worth it!

This serum feels light and absorbs fast without being sticky. I notice my skin looks brighter and smoother. It feels more firm and hydrated with regular use. I like that it is gentle and fragrance free so it doesn't irritate my skin.

In trying to find items to restart a skin care routine after years of neglect, this seemed like an excellent option. Combining Vitamin C and the hyped up PDRN seemed like a good idea, so I was willing to give it a shot. I won't say it gave miraculous results, but after a couple months of use and combined with a sunscreen in the morning, and retinaldehyde in the evening, my skin looks and feels smoother, hydrated, and overall just better. The scent is pleasant, a very light citrus that fades quickly, and the texture is also nice without a lot of slip or greasiness. It absorbs quickly, too. Overall, not a miracle product, but a very good product that's helped me out a lot!

reserve: With only 14 reviews total and just one mentioning a specific skin type, this is too small and generic a sample to draw confident conclusions about how the serum performs across different skin types or concerns.
